### Library

The steward's ledger lies open on a lectern, still ~~legible~~ mostly legible.

- Provisions
  - salt, six barrels
  - lamp oil, *plenty*
- Passwords
  - changed monthly
  - **never** written down — except here, in ink, with a note that the word
    itself is cut into the crypt wall

See also: [the keep's public record](https://example.com/keep).

choices.text: Leave the ledger shut and take the stair
